tenAnswers.question: 油价上涨后，为什么连买菜和送货也可能变贵？
tenAnswers.direct: 油价上涨不只影响加油：燃油变贵会推高运输成本，能源和化肥成本也会进入食品生产，因而买菜和送货都可能变贵。 [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: 工资没涨，经济增长的数据对家庭有什么意义？
tenAnswers.direct: GDP 增长表示全社会产出增加，不表示每个家庭工资都会增加。家庭是否更宽裕，要看自己的税后收入、收入分配和必要支出的价格。 [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: 矿产很多的地方，为什么就业和公共服务仍然薄弱？
tenAnswers.direct: 地下有资源不等于居民已经富裕。资源必须形成可获得的收入，再通过税收、公共投资和本地产业联系转化为就业与服务；这些环节失灵时，开采繁荣也可能没有带动多数家庭。 [1]

tenAnswers.question: 如果企业开始用人工智能，我应该观察哪些就业变化？
tenAnswers.direct: 先观察工作里的任务如何改变，而不是把使用 AI 等同于岗位消失。同一职业中，有些任务可被自动化，有些仍需人来判断、沟通或完成；岗位可能因此重组。 [1]

tenAnswers.question: 老年人口增加会如何改变家庭照护和劳动供给？
tenAnswers.direct: 老年人口比重上升，会同时改变需要照护的人数与能够投入工作的时间和人力。养老金、医疗和长期照护需求可能增加；实际劳动力变化仍取决于健康、退休安排与劳动参与。 [1]

tenAnswers.question: 为什么工厂选址要同时考虑用水、港口和供电？
tenAnswers.direct: 工业选址要同时看水、电和物流，因为生产投入、设备运行和货物流通必须衔接；其中一个环节不可靠，都可能使整个生产安排受阻。 [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: 远方战争如何传导到本地商品和运输成本？
tenAnswers.direct: 远方冲突可以通过商品供应和贸易路线传到本地：供应减少或航运受阻，会增加进口、生产和运输压力，再可能传到家庭支付的价格。 [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: 马来西亚与越南的制造业能直接用一个数字比较吗？
tenAnswers.direct: 不能用一个数字概括两国制造业。先确定比较的是经济中的比重、实际生产规模、就业、生产率还是产业构成；这些维度可能给出不同答案。 [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: 政策利率下降是否意味着每个人都更容易拿到房贷？
tenAnswers.direct: 降息可能降低新增或重新定价贷款的融资成本，但不等于每个人都更容易获批。贷款价格与能否通过银行审批，是两个需要分开核对的问题。 [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: 准备换工作时，怎样区分世界变化与自己的实际条件？
tenAnswers.direct: 先把世界趋势与自己的可核实条件分开，再比较方向。行业变化是背景；你的实际岗位要求、实得收入、通勤、照护时间和缓冲资金，才是判断某个选择是否可行的条件。 [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: Why can rising oil costs make groceries and deliveries more expensive?
tenAnswers.direct: Oil affects more than the fuel bill: dearer fuel raises transport costs, while energy and fertilizer costs enter food production. Groceries and deliveries can therefore become more expensive. [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: What does economic growth mean for a household whose wages have not risen?
tenAnswers.direct: GDP growth means greater total output, not a pay rise for every household. Whether a family is better off depends on its disposable income, distribution of gains and the prices of necessities. [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: Why can a mineral-rich place still have weak jobs and public services?
tenAnswers.direct: Resources underground do not automatically make residents prosperous. Revenues must be captured and converted into public investment and local economic links; extraction can expand without broad gains when those links fail. [1]

tenAnswers.question: If firms adopt artificial intelligence, what employment changes should I watch?
tenAnswers.direct: Watch changes in tasks before equating AI adoption with disappearing jobs. Some tasks can be automated while others still need people; a job can be reorganized rather than eliminated. [1]

tenAnswers.question: How can an older population change family care and labour supply?
tenAnswers.direct: An older population changes care demand and the people and time available for work. Pension, health and long-term care needs can grow, while labour supply still depends on health, retirement and participation. [1]

tenAnswers.question: Why does factory location depend on water, ports and electricity together?
tenAnswers.direct: Industrial location depends on water, power and logistics together because production inputs, operating equipment and moving goods must connect. An unreliable link can interrupt the production plan. [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: How can a distant war affect local goods and transport costs?
tenAnswers.direct: A distant conflict can reach local prices through commodity supply and trade routes: reduced supply or disrupted shipping can raise import, production and transport pressures that may reach households. [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: Can manufacturing in Malaysia and Vietnam be compared using a single number?
tenAnswers.direct: A single number cannot summarize two manufacturing sectors. First distinguish their economic share, production scale, employment, productivity and industry mix; these dimensions can give different answers. [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: Does a policy rate cut mean everyone can obtain a mortgage more easily?
tenAnswers.direct: A rate cut can lower financing costs for new or repriced loans, but does not mean everyone can qualify. The price of credit and eligibility for credit must be checked separately. [1][2]

tenAnswers.question: When considering a job change, how can I distinguish world trends from my own conditions?
tenAnswers.direct: Separate world trends from your own checkable conditions before comparing directions. Industry change is context; actual job requirements, take-home pay, commuting, care time and financial buffers determine whether an option fits. [1][2]
